promptState.text: A group photo of three friends and a small cartoon bunny on a sunny white stone terrace by the sea. From left to right, standing in one row on the same terrace floor with a little space between them: the blonde woman in the red dress from <ref_image_0>, the red-haired woman in the mustard yellow t-shirt from <ref_image_1> and the man in the navy blue suit from <ref_image_2>, their arms around each other's backs, smiling at the camera. At the right end of the row, beside the man and not in front of anyone, the bunny explorer from <ref_image_3>, a 3D cartoon character half as tall as a person, stands on the low white terrace wall so its head is level with the man's shoulder, and waves with its left paw raised, its right paw at its side. Each one keeps the face, the hair and the clothes from their picture. Behind them, the calm blue sea and a clear sky. Shot at eye level with a 35mm lens at f/5.6, every face sharp, framed from the thighs up with a little sky above their heads. Clear afternoon sunlight from the left lights every face, true-to-life colour, the look of an unedited photo.

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 FLUX 3 needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer, the first version with FLUX 3. On an older ComfyUI, Load CLIP has no flux3 type and some nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 FLUX 3 needs a free approval first (one time only)

Black Forest Labs keeps the FLUX 3 files behind a short approval on Hugging Face. Until you do it, every FLUX 3 download link below answers "Access to model ... is restricted ... Please log in".

  1. Log in to Hugging Face (a free account).
  2. Open the FLUX 3 model page with the button below and click Agree and access repository. Access is given at once.
  3. Now the download links below work, in the same browser.

FLUX 3 Klein on Hugging Face 

 Downloading with ComfyUI-Manager or a script needs a Hugging Face token as well (hf auth login). In the browser, being logged in is enough.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors5.83 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/flux3

Create the flux3 folder if it does not exist.

Take the file WITHOUT base in its name: that is the distilled (fast) model these workflows use. The files with base in the name are the base model, made for training LoRAs: it needs CFG 3.5 and 25 to 50 steps, and at the settings here (15 or 16 steps, CFG 1) its pictures come out smeared and broken.

Already have flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot.safetensors? That is the same file under its first name (ComfyUI's own template used it at launch). Pick it in this node instead of downloading it again.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors4.86 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download flux2-vae.safetensors336 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

The same file as Flux 2 Klein: if you have it, skip this one.

 License

FLUX 3 Image Klein is released under the FLUX Kommunity License. You may use the pictures commercially only while your yearly revenue (all the money coming in, before costs), together with any company you belong to, is under US$5 million. Read it before you use the model for paid work.

FLUX 3 Klein model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.183). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Put people from separate pictures into one group photo. FLUX 3 keeps each face and outfit and makes them stand together in a new place. The demo brings the two women, the man in the blue suit and the bunny explorer together on a terrace by the sea.

 Steps

  1. Load the first person in Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. picture 1).
  2. Load the second person in Load Image Mini Pixaroma (2. picture 2).
  3. Load the third person in Load Image Mini Pixaroma (3. picture 3).
  4. Load the bunny in Load Image Mini Pixaroma (4. picture 4).
  5. In Prompt Pixaroma, say who stands where, from left to right, then the place and the light.
  6. Pick the photo size on Sizes Pixaroma.
  7. Leave the seed on F to repeat a result, or switch it to R to try a new one every Run.
  8. Press Run.

 Pointing at each picture

  • In the prompt, <ref_image_0> is picture 1, <ref_image_1> picture 2, and so on: the order they are wired into Set Reference Multi Latent.
  • Name each thing with its picture: the man in the navy blue suit from <ref_image_2>, the bunny explorer from <ref_image_3>.
  • Say what stays the same from each picture: Each one keeps the face, the hair and the clothes from their picture.
  • The result has the size you pick on Sizes Pixaroma.

 There is no prompt upsampler in these workflows: with a detailed prompt like the demo's it added nothing in our tests, even shown all the pictures, and it needs 6.7 GB more memory. Write each picture's part out in full instead.

 Name each person by what is easy to see: the blonde woman in the red dress from <ref_image_0>. Ask for a close framing, framed from the thighs up, and 35mm, f/5.6, every face sharp: faces come out bigger and better than in a full-body shot.

 Stage it like a photographer

  • Put everyone in one row on the same floor, with a little space between them, and say who stands where from left to right.
  • Nobody in front of anybody. In our first try the bunny stood in front of a woman and the picture read wrong: was she sitting, holding it? Saying at the right end of the row, beside the man and not in front of anyone fixed it on all 4 seeds.
  • Say the size of anyone who is not an adult: half as tall as a person, standing on the low wall so its head is level with the man's shoulder.
  • Give hands one job each, or hide them: their arms around each other's backs.

 Good to know

  • In our tests all four were in the photo on every seed, each with their own face and clothes.
  • When the man held the bunny in his arms, it came out as a plush toy. Standing on its own, it stays a character.
  • Sizes are guessed: with no size in the prompt the bunny came out toy-sized or as tall as the people. Check it at 100% and change the size words if it looks wrong.
  • Four pictures take longer than one: about 16 s per Run.
  • To add a fifth person, wire another Load Image Mini Pixaroma into the next free image slot of Set Reference Multi Latent and call it <ref_image_4>. FLUX 3 takes up to 10 pictures.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video 

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"How to Use","icon":"to-do","color":"#2a9d8f"}}

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (FLUX 3 Klein, distilled) - The image model, FLUX 3 Image Klein from Black Forest Labs, the distilled version (no base in the file name): 16 steps for an edit, CFG 1. It makes a picture from words AND changes a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 4B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something FLUX 3 understands. The type must be flux3.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2 VAE) - Turns the finished render into a picture. FLUX 3 uses the same VAE as Flux 2.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. picture 1: first person) - Picture 1, called <ref_image_0> in the prompt: the first person, on the left. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (2. picture 2: second person) - Picture 2, called <ref_image_1> in the prompt: the second person. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (3. picture 3: third person) - Picture 3, called <ref_image_2> in the prompt: the third person. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (4. picture 4: the bunny) - Picture 4, called <ref_image_3> in the prompt: the bunny explorer, at the right end of the row. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (5. who stands where, the place) - Who stands where, from left to right, then the place and the light. The demo puts the four on a sunny terrace by the sea (see How to Use).
  • Sizes Pixaroma (6. photo size) - The size of the group photo. A group needs a wide picture: the demo is 1536 x 864.
  • Seed Pixaroma (7. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) repeats the result, R (random) tries a new one every Run. The demo uses seed 3.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the edit prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. FLUX 3 distilled runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Set Reference Multi Latent (the four pictures) - Hands the four pictures to FLUX 3, in order: <ref_image_0> to <ref_image_3>, each at about 1 megapixel. The group photo itself is painted on the blank canvas below it, at the Sizes Pixaroma size.
  • KSampler (16 steps) - The edit: 16 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings of Black Forest Labs' own FLUX 3 Klein distilled edit workflow.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (blank canvas) - The blank canvas the group photo is painted on, at the size it receives from Sizes Pixaroma.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the result) - Saves each result as PNG into ComfyUI/output/Flux 3 Klein Group Photo and shows it on the node.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
Four pictures, 1536 x 864about 16 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (FLUX 3 and its text encoder, about 11 GB together), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.
